row.name: acp_interactions_answer
row.value:
case "status"
        when 'pending' then num_nonnulls("answer", "sealed_answer", "answered_by", "answered_at") = 0
        when 'answered' then num_nonnulls("answer", "sealed_answer") = 1 and "answered_by" is not null and "answered_at" is not null
        else true end

row.name: chats_worker_selection
row.value: "worker" is null or "worker_selection" is not null

row.name: e2ee_chat_key_wraps_recipient_target
row.value: case "recipient" when 'identity' then "user_id" is not null and "workspace_epoch" is null else "user_id" is null and "workspace_epoch" is not null end

row.name: e2ee_chat_keys_binding
row.value: ("binding_signature" is null or "signature" is not null) and ("binding_members" is null or "binding_signature" is not null)

row.name: e2ee_join_requests_proof
row.value: num_nonnulls("mac", "owner_secret", "source_id", "epoch") = case when "source" = 'request' then 0 else 4 end

row.name: credential_limits_poll_error
row.value: num_nonnulls("poll_error_message", "poll_error_at") in (0, 2) and ("poll_error_status" is null or "poll_error_message" is not null)

row.name: notifications_subject
row.value:
("kind" in ('session_finished', 'session_approval', 'session_question', 'session_failed') and "chat" is not null and "limit_event" is null)
        or ("kind" not in ('session_finished', 'session_approval', 'session_question', 'session_failed') and "chat" is null and "limit_event" is not null)

row.name: notifications_delivery
row.value:
num_nonnulls("delivery_channel", "delivery_at", "delivery_devices") in (0, 3)
        and ("delivery_delivered" is null or "delivery_channel" is not null)

row.name: telemetry_blobs_sealed_envelope
row.value: "sealed_envelope" is null or ("sealed_epoch" is not null and "storage_key" is null)

row.name: telemetry_requests_error
row.value: "error_status" is null or "error_message" is not null

row.name: acp_usage_model_description
row.value: "model_description" is null or "model_id" is not null

row.name: worker_enrollments_completion
row.value: num_nonnulls("completion_worker", "completion_key", "completion_request_id") = case when "state" = 'completed' then 3 else 0 end
